column6: Within half a page, states what the system does, what state it is in, what is explicitly out of scope, and who to contact. No course jargon.
column9: States what the system does and what state it is in, but the exclusions name no specific feature or component, the contacts name no person or channel, the overview runs past half a page, or it uses course jargon.
column12: No overview, or a reader cannot tell what the system does or what state it is in.

column2: Setup: complete, copy-pasteable, verified by a fresh run [SO2]
column3: complete, copy-pasteable, and actually verified by a fresh run
column6: Setup instructions are complete and copy-pasteable, and the team verified them from a clean environment. A grader following them from a clean environment without help reaches a running system.
column9: Setup is mostly right but has gaps: an undocumented prerequisite, a step that fails without a stated workaround, or no evidence of a fresh-run verification.
column12: Setup cannot be followed to a running system.

column6: Open bugs carry severities and the tracker is linked; each piece of technical debt says whether it was intentional; future work is in priority order; and every credential, API key, or access permission is listed with its transfer status, or the section says there is nothing to transfer.
column9: A known-issues section exists, but bugs carry no severities, the tracker is not linked, technical debt does not say whether it was intentional, future work is unordered, or a credential or access permission has no transfer status.
column12: No known-issues section, or no credential and access list and no statement that there is nothing to transfer.

column3: requirements, design, and risks linked and current, decision record reachable
column6: The requirements, design, and risk documents are linked and current, and the decision record is reachable from the handoff.
column9: Docs are linked but one no longer describes the system that exists, or the decision record is not reachable from the handoff.
column12: Living docs are missing or unlinked, or two or more no longer describe the system that exists.

column2: Checklist, partner confirmation, and release consent [SO4]
column3: Checklist, written partner confirmation, and release-consent declaration all complete
column6: Handoff checklist complete, written partner confirmation attached, and the release-consent declaration lists every team member, with any NDA or partner restriction noted.
column9: Checklist and confirmation present, but a checklist item is unchecked with no reason and follow-up plan, the confirmation leaves out repository access, running the project, or the cost of maintaining it, the consent declaration leaves a member unnamed, or an NDA or partner restriction goes unstated.
column12: No written partner confirmation, or no release-consent declaration.
